interpretation_rules: an interval crossing zero means compatible with zero, not proof of no effect and not equivalence
equivalence is claimed only when the interval lies wholly inside [-epsilon,+epsilon]
negative effects are preserved exactly as measured
no best-start, repeat, prefix or subset selection was applied
failed starts are retired, reported, and never retried under this frozen campaign
cdx0 numbers are layer-replay completion times, not server-side latencies

results judge only the cross-domain execution-time response among the chosen captures, the two layers (024, 071) and the candidate layouts at replay caliber; NO full-service benefit or harm conversion in either direction
own-base tracking is one pre-registered screening summary, NOT a necessary condition for cross-domain tracking value; the full matrix is reported regardless

statistics.contrast_orientation_note: primary contrasts oriented as T(other-base) - T(own-base): positive means own base faster; own_base_vs_identity oriented as T(own) - T(identity): negative means own base faster than identity
statistics.df_rule: valid_starts - 1 (df=3 with 4 valid starts; df=2 with 3)

verdict_rules.detected: >=1 of the 2 layers shows clear crossover advantage
verdict_rules.exploratory_label: all 24 primary contrasts and every verdict derived from them are EXPLORATORY screening labels; no FWER control claimed; confirmatory use requires a new pre-registered protocol
verdict_rules.indeterminate: any layer indeterminate and none clear
verdict_rules.layer_indeterminate: >=2 rows with fewer than 3 valid starts
verdict_rules.not_detected: 0 layers show it and no layer is indeterminate
verdict_rules.not_detected_meaning: the pre-registered screen did not fire on these two layers and candidates at replay caliber; NOT evidence of absence of exploitable cross-domain structure
verdict_rules.row_tracks_own_base: all three other-base-minus-own-base paired 95% CIs exclude zero positively (epsilon plays no role)
